information:
¡Bienvenidos al Evento al Qbo 2023!

Para participar de esta competencia, deberas obtener una entrada de **competidor** para "Evento al Qbo" ($200 pesos uruguayos)

Habrá registros el día del evento con un costo de 300 pesos uruguayos.
 
**Para conocer todos los detalles, por favor leer [IMPORTANTE](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EventoalQbo2023#27909-importante-important) y [PAGO](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EventoalQbo2023#27884-pago-payment).**

---

Welcome to Evento al Qbo 2023!

To participate in this competition, you must obtain a **competitor** ticket for "Evento al Qbo" ($200 Uruguayan pesos)

On the spot registrations will be accepted with a cost of $300 Uruguayan pesos.

**To know everything you need, please refer to the [IMPORTANT](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EventoalQbo2023#27909-importante-important) and [PAYMENT](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EventoalQbo2023#27884-pago-payment) tabs.**
